status: discovery experiment fixed before this lane computes outcomes; all history is reused and not an untouched holdout
purpose: Determine whether aggressive concentration, relative leadership, repair timing, and causal capital displacement supply useful candidates beyond original-ten unqualified native models; preserve natural and equally levered QQQ comparisons.
universe_limit: Fixed contemporary ETF identities, not a point-in-time census of every fund. XLC/XLRE only after 252 contiguous observed sessions. Excludes SOXX to avoid presenting duplicate semiconductor exposure as a second independent industry.

rules.QQQ_HOLD: 98% QQQ for cash account; target gross1.5 for margin account; buy once, margin controls can reduce.
rules.SMH_HOLD: same for SMH; named aggressive sector control, selected with full knowledge of prior semiconductor leadership, not blind selection
rules.LEADER1: month-end: choose largest 126-session log return among available universe; 98% or1.5 gross in one fund
rules.LEADER3: month-end equal targets in three largest126-session log returns
rules.RELATIVE3: month-end select up to3 ETFs excluding QQQ with largest positive126-session log return minus QQQ; each gets1/3 target gross; empty slots go to QQQ
rules.VOLADJ3: month-end top3 of positive126-session QQQ-relative log return divided by prior63-session daily volatility; empty slots QQQ
rules.ACCEL3: month-end positive acceleration=(21-session log return minus126-session log return/6), divided by63-session volatility; require close>SMA200 and126-session return>QQQ; top3; empty slots QQQ
rules.REPAIR3: month-end rank126-session relative winners; require price2%-10% below trailing20-session highest close, past3-session return>0, close>SMA200; top3; empty slots QQQ
rules.ESCAPE1: month-end highest126-session return among funds whose close>SMA200 and126-session log return>0; cash if none

execution: Signals only completed month-end close; last available previous month-end governs inception. Next observed QQQ session open proxy. Desired adjusted units frozen using that open and pretrade NAV; sells first. Unfilled units persist until next rebalance. Cash proceeds are unavailable until T+3 before2017-09-05, T+2 until2024-05-24, T+1 from2024-05-28. Margined accounts may reuse receivables, charge10% annual on net debit daily including weekends; no claim actual broker permission/rate. No shorts/options. Maintenance: if previous close gross/NAV>2, proportional reduction target1.5 at next open. Terminal net wealth reserves sell fee on all remaining positions. Fractional adjusted research units and adjusted prices are not actual share/cash-distribution execution; no forward receipts or broker fills asserted.
output: all300accounts, dated NAV/cash/debt/receivable/holdings/fills, returns/CAGR/maxdrawdown/fees/interest, excess against equally funded gross0.98QQQ and corresponding grossQQQ; no best-only deletion; input hashes
selection_rule: No automatic deployment. Research candidate requires late net wealth>QQQ at matching gross AND natural cash QQQ at all fee cells with both providers; report early and long-window failure without overriding. Same-gross return advantage not risk-adjusted alpha. New native-price forward trial required.
